channel.title: Vintage Story Mod DB - Latest Updates
channel.description: Newest mod releases and updates from the Vintage Story Mod DB

item.title: Immersive HUD
item.description: Replaces the hud's health, hunger, and breathing bars with in game effects/overlays.

item.title: Player Chunk Ghost Fix
item.description: Fixes nearby players turning invisible and not hearable until relog

item.title: World Status HUD
item.description: Real-time, unobtrusive player stats at a glance.

item.title: Collectible Metadata Editor
item.description: Edit tags, stats and recipes of any item or block from an ingame admin menu

item.title: recipesearchfix
item.description: fixes the recipes reiterating through 100k varients.

item.title: Teapot's Undead Legion
item.description: Armed undead Revenants roam the night. Bind your own with a Temporal Core and lead them to battle!

item.title: Mining Expanded
item.description: Mine air and ventilation, firedamp, dust, blasting, ore quality, cribs and miner's hard hats.

item.title: Aegis Claims
item.description: Chunk claims for civilization servers, with nations, player towns, capitals and an admin painter on

item.title: Bread In Trough
item.description: Adds bread to small and large troughs

item.title: ChiselControl
item.description: Carve what you want easier, more efficiently, with professional tools.

item.title: Dogs Companion
item.description: This mod adds new breeds of domestic dogs to the game.

item.title: Insulated Japanese Architecture
item.description: The same Japanese Archictecture but with insolation and more wood types.

item.title: Better Fruit Press
item.description: Makes the fruit press quicker and allows squeezing over barrels.

item.title: Veshk
item.description: Large predatory leech-like creatures which feed on blood

item.title: Rot Bin
item.description: Rot food and age alcohol.

item.title: Eventide Claims
item.description: Claim maps, settlements, and access permissions for the Eventide server.

item.title: Scarecrow
item.description: With the scarecrow you get an effective solution to a plague of hares and raccoons in your garden.

item.title: Better Pyrolysis
item.description: Adds several new features regarding pyrolyzing different fuels in coke ovens.

item.title: Kith
item.description: Host your world for friends, comes with an island hub, cosmetics, emotes, and chat.

item.title: Character Presets
item.description: Save and apply previously created characters in the character creation screen.

item.title: Rough Seas
item.description: The sea gets weather: storms, surf, currents. And six new vessels that wear, swamp and break.

item.title: LocalRUAddon
item.description: Русские переводы модов Vintage Story для игры с друзьями

item.title: The Rookery
item.description: Real messenger birds that fly your letters across the world and can be shot down, plus wild birds

item.title: Immersive Hideworking
item.description: Immersive tanning racks for realistic hide processing, scraping, salting, oiling, and curing.

item.title: SequenceMod
item.description: Storyteller Commands

item.title: fragTweaks
item.description: various mod tweaks and overwrites utilized on Fragments RP

item.title: fCombatBalance
item.description: Combat and Item Balance for Fragments RP.

item.title: Cargo Clothing
item.description: Cargo pants, overalls, pockets, tool belts, sheaths and waxed clothes that keep the rain off.

item.title: Sabersnout Leviathan
item.description: Adds a hostile aquatic creature to lakes and oceans.

item.title: Quiet Helve Hammer, Works in 1.22.*
item.description: Quiets the helve hammer anvil with a new low thud.
